traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Nyssaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire or dentate; veins pinnate; leaves evergreen; stipules absent; plants monoecious, dioecious or polygamous; ovary inferior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers solitary, in racemes, in heads or in umbels; flowers actinomorphic or zygomorphic; perianth usually sepals and petals, sometimes tepals; fruit drupe or samara; stamens (8-) 10 (-15); carpels (1-) 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
